diagnosis.source_log_entry_icon: Neither Vue nor San source defines a separate icon inside each log item; the comparable element is the colored INFO/WARNING/ERROR level badge.
diagnosis.vue_manual_runner_limitation: The Vue manual page rendered one chart wrapper although the Vue source declares both CPU and memory charts. The user chose not to resolve the Vue runner discrepancy in this round, so full chart visual parity is not established.
